notes.title: Early Access Begins! Plus New Info on Special Bundles and Soundtrack Release!
notes.content:
◆ Early Access is Now Live!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/746e9b2f704249ff76434944864be4899d61d269.png"]The globally acclaimed puzzle game “Fruit Mountain,” beloved for its simple yet profound gameplay, has now been reborn as the brand-new competitive party game “Fruit Mountain Party.”



Carrying over the original rule of merging the same fruits to grow them bigger, this new entry transforms the experience into a strategic and heated battle. With powerful items, clever tactics, and thrilling mind games, players can enjoy the action solo or in matches of up to four players.




◼︎ Discover the Greatly Enhanced Features in Early Access!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/b247e91680870eb99264dbdf122e2ed81ecc5cfd.jpg"]
① Enjoy “Battle Mode” Anytime, Anywhere
"Fruit Battle" Mode

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/dbd7a5470a3c5f627936a36d1b0a4251d7fc9e78.png"]In the offline “Fruit Battle” mode, you can enjoy “Solo Play” against COM players, or dive into “Multiplayer” matches with family and friends.



"Online Versus" Mode[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/39799c8e1343e75b13ac5b161263b8214dd2cb55.png"]In the online “Versus Mode”, you can battle players from around the world through “Random Match”, or take on specific opponents using the “Room Match” feature. Plus, with Steam’s Remote Play Together, you can even enjoy matches with friends who don’t own the game themselves.

Note: To use Remote Play Together, invited players will also need a Steam® account.



"Time Attack" Mode[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/f7d771bbaec4c28cae83c33ddc9d58380fcd57c9.png"]Compete against the computer while aiming for the fastest time to make the largest fruit, the watermelon. If you use items well, you may be able to significantly improve your records!




② New “Game Rules” to Test Your Skills, Plus Dozens of Fresh Fruits!
Standard Race[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/3550ead1bfd3e7a59ea5fdfcfb69d0552093a2f3.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/81b4e4028174fe55f80b5e142cbefd604a384c82.png"]

Toss fruits onto the plate, merge the same types to create bigger ones, and compete for the highest score against your opponents. If you manage to complete the ultimate fruit—the Watermelon—within the time limit, you instantly win! Will you play it safe for points, or aim for a one-shot victory? The choice—and the mind games—are yours.



Thief Frenzy[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/f01c91221ca0d9cb436b0e378749debb2fc8e27a.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/4685dea7c60e9eb577fb9fe654e9d3f590a4a431.png"]In this mode, the appearance rate of the “Fruit Thief” item skyrockets! Alongside newly added quirky-shaped fruits like Cherries and Purple Grapes, the thrill lies in stealing fruits from other players—or having yours stolen in return. Expect nonstop tension and wild, unpredictable twists, with heated comebacks in the final moments making this a truly high-energy game rule.

 

Fruit of the Sun[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/90347179f15f13264297ebf0eb6072103b472795.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/60d22a14d31a9808af5757ac8974691e70cea4d0.png"]All fruits are newly introduced in this mode—and they’re all golden. With color no longer a reliable cue, confusion is inevitable. You’ll have to rely on shapes and subtle details, making quick yet careful judgments. A single mistake can swing the match—watch out for look-alikes!



Even more game rules are planned to be added by the time of the official release—so stay tuned!





 
◆ The Evolution Continues! Upcoming Update Information!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/7804122d3d780f2d6e0bfb9c923f231aef528daa.png"]
To make “Fruit Mountain Party” even more enjoyable for players around the world, we plan to continue strengthening features and adding new competitive elements. The first milestone will be on September 25, when we release an Update Version featuring five brand-new elements. Later in 2025, we’ll deliver the Full Release, further polished with feedback gathered from Early Access!

Details on the new elements coming in the update will be announced at a later date—so stay tuned for more information!


[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
Notice of Free Demo Distribution Ending

With the launch of the Early Access version of Fruit Mountain Party, the free demo distribution has come to an end.The feedback and comments we received through the demo have been an invaluable support to our development.We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who played.
We hope you will now enjoy the evolved Fruit Mountain Party in its Early Access version.
[/td][/tr][/table]





◆ Special Bundle Sale Information
With the start of Early Access, we’ve prepared several special bundle offers. If you’re interested in the Fruit Mountain series, be sure to check them out!


① Fruit Mountain Double Pack (10% OFF the regular price)  
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57391/"][/dynamiclink]A value bundle that includes both titles in the series: “Fruit Mountain Party” and “Fruit Mountain.”


② Fruit Mountain Party & SOUNDTRACK (15% OFF the regular price)
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57390/"][/dynamiclink]A set including the full game “Fruit Mountain Party” along with the Original Soundtrack, featuring four tracks used in the game.

Note: The soundtrack is also available separately without the full game.


③ Fruit Mountain Complete Pack (20% OFF the regular price)  
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57393/"][/dynamiclink]A full bundle including both main titles—“Fruit Mountain” and “Fruit Mountain Party”—along with the soundtracks for each game, for a total of four pieces of content from the series.



Note: If you already own part of the content included in this bundle, you can purchase the remaining items at a discounted price.

notes.title: The free demo of Fruit Mountain Party has been renewed based on your feedback!
notes.content:
We have released Ver.1.1.0 with the following updates:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/c193d6875f044b42f6c4a2ccdafd65c78d80452d.jpg"]
Update Details
Revamped “Single Play” Mode

The previous “Practice with CPU” mode has been reborn as “Single Play”!

What was once a 1v1 format has now been expanded into a 4-player battle featuring the player plus three CPU opponents.

Even when playing solo, you can now fully experience the strategic depth and excitement that the game is all about.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/6243763f939867d935abfee869f22b7d0201e164.jpg"]

Selectable Waiting Method for Random Matches

You can now choose how long to wait when entering a Random Match:
“Short” (up to 60 seconds)
“Long”

If you select “Short” and matchmaking doesn’t complete within 60 seconds, CPU players will be added to start a 4-player match.

If you select “Long,” the game will keep waiting until you’re matched with other players.
A 60-second countdown begins when you’re first matched with another player.
Once the timer reaches zero, the game starts with the number of players currently waiting in the matchmaking queue.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/ce5edcc1d5eb17d710e178d819a9ec94c70daec1.jpg"]

Various UI Adjustments

We’ve updated various UI elements in accordance with the above changes.

Whether you’re trying the demo for the first time or have been playing since its initial release, this new version offers a refreshed experience.

The updated demo is now available on Steam starting today!






Introducing the Game Rules! See what's changed for versus play!

The basic rules are unchanged from the previous title.
Combine fruits of the same kind to make them bigger!

Keep growing your fruits bigger and bigger to aim for victory!




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/42a14388087c83220b5353b48386b19b7199d892.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/8b455b1c9a23d92d6f57c78a3c968163fd800c2a.png"]



Victory goes to the player who earns the highest score in 4 minutes, or the one who creates a watermelon first! It's up to you which strategy to pursue: focus intensely on making many large fruits to rack up your score, or carefully aim to complete a watermelon.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/c732b67bab26607f4176d88fe1ef424d5d2503bb.jpg"]



In this game, dropping fruit won't end your run; you can keep playing!
In Fruit Mountain, if fruit fell off the plate, it was game over. But in Fruit Mountain Party, that won't happen. However, dropping fruit will result in a score deduction and you'll lose any items you've acquired. So, try your best not to let them fall!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/cde7170ece95c29b9d056675063d1d01c1149024.png"]




Interfere with your opponents using Jammer Fruit and Items!
When you create a large fruit, the Jammer Fruit will be sent to your rival. Send them many to interfere with their game.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/c499fdae602f7ede887f2b8e662deb08aff14005.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/9c6095dec8f339506b85290709bb2ec36e1a51c9.jpg"]



 Additionally, making large fruits will also cancel out any the Jammer Fruit your rival sends your way. the Jammer Fruit will drop at the location of the gray marker.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/28ec9143a09b6ae7050b51baaad0fce5afe0b389.jpg"]

You'll randomly get an 'Item' when your Item Gauge is full! The Item Gauge fills up by throwing in fruits or by chaining combos. You can use an item by pressing the X button or the Z key.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/7383cfb7ef99328ebc5253eb316acf7ebde16470.png"]




There are 7 types of items!
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/da4ecc5308fc757bf63465b47323f6aa9914bba9.png"]
[/td][td]
\[Paint]

Hurl paint to cover a random player's screen, obstructing their view.



[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/3546cc1dc2ec33e47aff40faa6bc051098552265.png"]
[/td][td]
\[Upgrade]

Increases the size of the fruit in your hand by one stage.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/75c5e5c47ac0a9cd3cc4e4a9f7491e5d8e984372.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/6cc165799db49985f41580d393701e7b57135fa6.png"]
[/td][td]
\[Jammer Fruit / Jammer Fruitx3] 

Drops Jammer Fruit onto a random player's plate.



[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/ebbbce9f9eea830266f0c29c3abcbe1e90439adc.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/361f4b350bf5c36bf909b57d9839550b6182039f.png"]
[/td][td]
\[Minus Fruit / Minus Fruitx3]

Drops Minus fruit onto a target player's plate, shrinking their fruit.



[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/5c1cbfaa4b6d492cff9e645cd7a9e1ef706e8cc9.png"]
[/td][td]
\[Fruit Thief]

Steals the second-largest fruit from a target player's plate.
[/td][/tr][/table]


Keep growing your fruits to send back Jammer Fruit' and utilize various 'Items' to gain an advantage!





The demo will remain free to play even after the Steam Next Fest concludes. 

Our staff also join random matches, so be sure to challenge them!






Here are the details for #3 of our campaign to cheer on Fruit Mountain Party!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/c36f62edd1acdb4f2f742b2720ab0bb986f345ae.png"]

We’re now recruiting supporters to help cheer on the release of Fruit Mountain Party!
Curators, reviewers, streamers, bloggers, media—you’re all welcome!



Supporters will receive a Steam key to play Fruit Mountain Party ahead of its public release, so join us in spreading the excitement!
Honest feedback—no matter how critical—is more than welcome.
Your input will help us make Fruit Mountain Party a game that even more players can enjoy!



To join the cheer squad, please fill out the form below with your cheer style, the number of keys you’re requesting, and other required details:



Application Form:
 https://forms.gle/UgQK7nT4LrKVGN9s9



*If there are too many applicants, selection may be done via lottery.



So, we would love it if you could please join us in building excitement around the game!



Try the Demo Here

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3697250/_/"][/dynamiclink]



Thank you as always for your continued cheer and enthusiasm for Fruit Mountain Party!

notes.title: Fruit Mountain Party demo is out now!
notes.content:
Steam demo of Fruit Mountain Party
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/d21342abb84a9d17d161839332aa628e4e00caa9.png"]Starting June 9th, the demo for Fruit Mountain Party is now available and ready for online play. Battle it out alongside friends and challenges from all around the world to be the reigning monarch of fruit!

The fully released build of the game will feature additional modes to suit a variety of playstyles. There will be a single-player mode whereby players can practice or play against the CPU, local battles on a single PC and online battles, including an invitation-based matching system.






Take on randomized matching in “Fruit Race”
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/b441b3993fced1c2ac2d65360cfc44e752091966.jpg"]In the demo version of this mode, players will be matched up against random opponents from around the world. Stack your fruit on the stage and the first player to make a watermelon (the largest fruit in the game) will be named the winner.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/fc0a4668ef78f381919fb3d3f7c1f844685680fe.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/13316512e2e2bd5ba8e48105d0add1653984cd00.jpg"]This mode also has a new system that features a gauge. You can fill this gauge by throwing fruit and combining fruits on the stage. Once it’s full, players will be able to use unique items with some devastating effects! There’s even a “Minus Fruit” item which will shrink your opponent’s fruit so watch out!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/9f8993be5475abdc7a330dbea62a3d13d5b3f8dd.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526939/ce901d891cca272426064b09185edf6768ae4ba4.jpg"]Don’t forget “solo play” mode where you can get your practice in against the CPU while still following the typical rules of Fruit Mountain Party. Use this mode to warm up before the real battles begin, or just unwind in your spare time through some low stakes play.



Don’t miss out on the chance to play Fruit Mountain Party! Play the free demo version and enjoy heated fruit x puzzle battles!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467540/_/"][/dynamiclink]


Participation in Steam Next Fest Confirmed! Special Campaigns Planned During the Event!
We are excited to announce that Fruit Mountain Party will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, taking place from Tuesday, June 9 to Monday, June 16, 2025! During the event, we’ll also be running three major support campaigns, offering gifts and prizes!



Everyone who plays the free demo and completes the survey will receive an originally designed wallpaper for PC and smartphones!

Your feedback and comments will be used to improve future updates.
